  "text": "Ada did not run. Her boot was pinned beneath the yellow door, and Venn’s wrist was still inside the wall.

“Back through the passage,” she told Mara.

Mara shook her head and pushed the match into the crack beside Venn’s arm. The flame bent sideways. Somewhere behind the stone, something drew a breath.

The constable seized his left wrist. The black line slipped from under his thumb and wound once around his finger.

“I never came through that door,” he said.

The knocking stopped.

Elias backed away from him. “Then who did?”

The constable’s uneven heel tapped twice against the floor, followed by a slow scrape. His face went slack. The yellow door pressed harder against Ada’s boot.

She tore the page from the ledger. The word RUN split down its middle. On the sheet beneath it, ink spread into a rough drawing of the cellar: the yellow door, Venn’s wall, and a narrow rectangle behind where Ada stood.

She turned. Mortar dust sifted from the sealed stone. A gap had opened at its base, wide enough to admit a hand.

“Venn,” she said. “Can you pull free?”

He shook his head. Mara caught his shoulder as the wall tugged again.

Ada knelt and fed the torn page into the gap. A hand took it. Its fingers were stained with ink.

The pressure on the yellow door eased. Venn wrenched his wrist loose and fell against Mara. Across the cellar, the constable’s heel became still.

From the gap came the sound of paper being folded. Then the hand held out a smaller square, marked with a single word: WAIT."
